name: shine-salary-mcp
description: Read-only access to Shine Salary payroll data: companies, employees, payroll runs, payslips and time registrations.
long_description: Six read-only tools over the Salary.dk API. Personal identifiers (CPR, addresses, contact details, bank and pension accounts) are never returned. Run `shine-salary-mcp login` once in a terminal before using it; credentials live in the OS keychain.

tools.name: salary_company_overview
tools.description: Companies available, and for one company: status, active payroll periods and warnings.

tools.name: salary_find_employees
tools.description: List or search employees by name or employee number.

tools.name: salary_employee_summary
tools.description: One employee: employment, contract, salary rows, pension scheme and benefits.

tools.name: salary_payroll_overview
tools.description: Payroll runs in a date range with totals; one run with deviations and transfers.

tools.name: salary_payslip_summary
tools.description: Payslips with net pay and labelled key figures (A-skat, AM-bidrag, ATP, pension…).

tools.name: salary_time_summary
tools.description: Time and leave registrations totalled per employee (not a leave balance).
